units.spine: The Guild Council has the approval of the town, and the margin of that approval pays for decisions the place would otherwise refuse.
The Guild Council's standing rests on the town's prosperity and is exactly as sound as the prosperity.
A traveller doing business at Spitzplatz needs one name and gets one answer, and can plan a season ahead on the strength of it.
Nobody here needs the trouble explained. The market levies are named, and the quarrel behind them is common knowledge.
The books of several houses here are in perfect order, and the order is the thing being bought.
The town cannot say in one word how it is governed, and neither can the hall.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: The town gives the hall its full title in public and something shorter everywhere else, and both are exact.
The Guild Council keeps its hold on the town, and that hold is weighed again every season.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public backing hardens the hold
units.spine: There are people here who would move on the Guild Council and do not, because moving on a seat the town is behind costs more than the seat is worth.
